THE RAINFOREST PHILOSOPHY

Adopt the pace of nature.

Rain Forest Hotel was created as a peaceful sanctuary in the heart of Kuala Lumpur—a place where you can step away from urban noise, slow down, and feel at home.

Tucked safely in vibrant Chinatown on historic Jalan Petaling, our restored shophouse offers clean, quiet, air-conditioned rooms, refreshing showers, and genuine local hospitality to help you recharge and let your journey unfold naturally.

A Look Inside

Need to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

What time is check-in and check-out?

Standard check-in is from 2:00 PM (14:00) and check-out is by 12:00 PM. Subject to availability, early check-in is allowed starting from 12:00 PM, and late check-out is charged at RM 10 per hour.

Do you serve breakfast?

Yes, we serve a complimentary simple breakfast every morning from 8:30 AM to 11:00 AM.

How do I get there from the airport?

The fastest way between the hotel and KLIA is taking the Kelana Jaya LRT line from Pasar Seni station (a short walk from us) to KL Sentral, which connects directly to the KLIA Ekspres train.

Are there any additional taxes or fees?

Our additional taxes and charges are as follows:

  • Tourist Tax: RM 10 per room per night for foreign guests.
  • Early Check-in / Late Check-out: RM 10 per hour (earliest check-in starts from 12:00 PM).
  • Key Card Deposit: RM 50 refundable deposit per room card collected upon check-in.
Is parking available on-site?

No, there is no parking available on-site. We recommend guests arriving by car or Grab plan accordingly.
